answer: Escalating-Lock Stake Vouching. An agent may harbor a newcomer only by locking stake: the i-th concurrent vouch locks 20i tokens, and all of it is slashed if any vouchee is caught. One sponsor harboring a 50-identity farm locks 20×1,275=25,500 tokens, not 1,000, and a whisper vouch below that lock carries zero weight. Failure mode, the reef: sybils vouch for each other in a ring to keep i small. It still costs them because vouch weight counts only stake earned from non-ring counterparties, and one detected member slashes the whole reef.
